summary: Sixth Street Lending Partners, a Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fifth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, covering a $750 million private placement of 6.500% senior unsecured notes due December 15, 2031, sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Interest pays semiannually from December 15, 2026; the deal closed September 21, 2026, alongside execution of the indenture. Proceeds will repay revolving credit and subscription facility borrowings and fund general corporate purposes. Covenants track Section 18(a)(1)(A) as modified by Section 61(a) of the Investment Company Act; a change-of-control plus downgrade triggers a 100% par repurchase offer. Watch asset coverage, leverage, and any open-market note trading as pricing signals.
